encode_text_to_indices: encode a text string into a list of word indices using SimpleTokenizer
decode_indices_to_words: decode a list of word indices back into words using SimpleTokenizer
build_vocabulary_from_data: build a vocabulary from train, validation, and test data samples using SimpleTokenizer
add_word_to_vocab: add a new word to the SimpleTokenizer vocabulary with an auto-assigned index
get_tokenizer_from_config: get a SimpleTokenizer instance from a config using the get_tokenizer factory function
